cs.t: I just bought a boox go color 2. Kindle form factor, color e-ink screen, runs android, supports stylus. I don't know if I love it yet but I read seven ebooks in a month on it, so I guess it's been a good purchase. The android kindle app has a neat smooth scrolling feature that works really well.
